title: Contains Duplicate
description: Check if any value appears more than once in the array.

data.text: Given an integer array `nums`, return `true` if any value appears more than once.
Add each number to a set. If it's already there, we found a duplicate. O(n) time, O(n) space.

data.title: HashSet O(n)

data.text: Sort the array first, then scan once checking neighbors. O(n log n) time, O(1) extra space if sorting in-place.

data.title: Sort + Scan O(n log n)

data.text: Use `Distinct()` to remove duplicates and compare the count to the original length. Concise but allocates an enumerator. O(n) time, O(n) space.

data.title: LINQ O(n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n) → O(n log n) for sort variant. **Space:** O(n) → O(1). The HashSet approach is preferred when mutating the input is not allowed.
